senses.gloss:
(औ ऌ) औ शदॢ r. 1st and 6th cls. (शीयते)
1 To perish gradually, to wither or decay.
2 To fall.
3 To throw down.
4 To go, to move.

m. (-दः)
A vegetable, any edible vegetable product, as fruits, roots, &c.
E.
शद to wither, aff. अच्.

m. (-दः)
1 Mud.
2 Young grass.
E.
शो to wither, द Uṇādi aff.

(औ ॡ) औषदॢ^1 r. 1st and 6th cls. (सीदति)
1 To wither, to wane, to perish gradually.
2 To be low-spirited, to despond, to be weary or distressed, to lack energy.
3 To break or destroy.
4 To go or move.
With आङ् prefixed,
आषदॢ r. 1st and 10th cls. (आसादति आसादयति)
1 To go.
2 To assail, to encounter.
With अव prefixed,
1 To be exhausted or languid.
2 To finish.
With आङ्,
To obtain, to attain, to reach or arrive at.
With उत्,
1 To ascend.
2 To destroy.
With उप,
To approach.
With नि,
1 To sit in or on.
2 To stand.
3 To protect.
With प्र,
1 To be propitious to, to favour or be pleased with.
2 To please or propitiate.
3 To purify.
4 To smile.
With वि,
To be languid or sorrowful.
With सम्,
1 To attain.
2 To be in company or society with.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161123. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/321. note: Devanagari 'w' and 'd' difficult to distinguish.

m. (-दः)
The fruit of trees.
E.
षद to go, अच् aff.

ind.
Always, at all times.
E.
स for सर्व्व all, दाच् aff.

m. (-दः)
1 Purity, cleanness.
2 Lassitude, weariness, exhaustion.
3 Perishing, decay.
E.
षट् to decay, to be weary, &c., aff. घञ्.

m. (-द्रिः)
1 A cloud.
2 An elephant.
3 ARJUNA.
f. (-द्रिः)
Lightning.
4 Clayed or candied sugar.
E.
शद to go, क्रिन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-द्रुः-द्रुः-द्रु)
1 Wasting, decaying.
2 Going, moving.
E.
शद to go, रु aff.

mfn. (-द्रुः-द्रुः-द्रु)
1 Resting, staying.
2 Going.
E.
सद to go or sit, रु aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Green or fresh with young grass.
E.
शाद young grass, and हरित green

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Abounding in fresh or green grass.
E.
शाद young grass, द्वलच् aff.

m. (-कः)
A crab.
E.
स with, दंशक a tooth.

m. (-नः)
A heron.
E.
स with, दंश a tooth or beak, and वदन face.

n. (-नं)
Calx of brass.
E.
सत् good, excellence, अञ्जन stibium.

n. (-नं)
1 A house.
2 Water.
3 Perishing, decaying.
4 Exhaustion.
E.
षद to go or perish, aff. युच्.

n. (-नं)
1 A house, a dwelling.
2 Dispelling.
3 Destroying.
4 Wearying, exhausting.
5 Exhaustion, decay.
E.
षद to go, causal v., ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Benevolent, compassionate.
E.
स with, दया clemency.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Fearful, afraid.
E.
स with, दर fear.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Respectful.
n. adv. (-रं)
Respectfully.
E.
स with, आदर respect.

fn. (-दाः-दः)
An assembly, a meeting.
E.
षद to go, (to which,) Uṇādi aff. असुन्.

mfn. (-सन्-सती-सत्)
1 Existent and non-existent.
2 True and false.
3 Perceptible and non-perceptible.
E.
सत्, and असत् untrue, &c.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Being both real and unreal, existent and non-existent, substantial though imperceptible.
E.
सदसत्, and आत्मक self.

m. (-कः)
Discrimination between true and false, &c.
E.
सदसत्, and विवेक judgment.

m. (-स्यः)
1 An assistant or by-stander at a sacrifice, &c. one whose business it is to notice and correct mistakes.
2 Any person present at an assembly, a spectator, an assessor, a member, &c.
E.
सदस् an assembly, यत् aff.

m. (-तिः)
1 The sun.
2 Air, wind.
3 Final happiness, emancipation from life.
4 The Supreme Spirit.
E.
सदा always, गति going, duration.

m. (-रः)
The traditionary observances of the Hindu castes, as preserved in the land lying between the Sarasvatī and Dṛṣadvatī rivers.
2 Virtuous conduct.
E.
सत् pure, virtuous, and आचार observance.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Eternal.
m. (-नः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
सदा always, ट्युल् aff.

f. (-या)
A plant, (Mimosa octandra.)
E.
सदा always, and तोय water.

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
Good, virtuous.
E.
सत्, and आत्मन् self.

n. (-नं)
Liberality, munificence.
m. (-नः)
1 The elephant of INDRA.
2 A name of GAṆEŚA.
3 An elephant in must.
E.
सदा always, दान giving, or the ichor that exudes from the elephant's temples.

mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं)
Always happy.
E.
सदा, and आनन्द happiness.

m. (-र्त्तः)
A wagtail.
E.
सदा always, नर्त्त a dancer.

f. (-हा)
A small river in the north of Bengal.
E.
सदा always, नीर water, वह bearing.

f. (-रा)
The Karatoya, a small river in the north of Bengal.
E.
सदा always, नीर water.

m. (-ष्पः)
The cocoanut.
f. (-ष्पी)
A shrub, gigantic swallow-wort, the white variety.
E.
सदा always, and पुष्प a flower.

m. (-लः)
1 The cocoanut tree.
2 The glomerous fig tree.
3 The jack, (Artocarpus integrifolia?)
4 The Bel, (Ægle marmelos.)
E.
सदा always, and फल fruit.

mf. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
Attentive, present.
E.
सदा always, भव्य being.

f. (-द्रा)
A shrub, (Gmelina arborea.)
E.
सदा always, भद्र auspicious.

m. (-गी)
VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA.
E.
सदा always, योग union by meditation, &c., इनि aff.

m. (-वः)
ŚIVA.
E.
सदा always, शिव auspicious.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Attached or belonging to the virtuous, pure, good, lovely, &c.
2 Always connected with or dependant on.
E.
सत् good, &c., or सदा always, and आश्रित connected.

n. (-रं)
A proper or good reply.
E.
सत्, and उत्तर answer.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
Like, similar.
E.
स for सम् same, दृक्ष to see, क्म aff.

mfn. (-दृक्)
Like, similar.
E.
स for सम् same, दृश to see, aff. क्विप्.

mfn. (-शः-शी-शं)
1 Like, resembling, similar.
2 Fit, proper, right.
E.
स for सम् the same, दृश to see, aff. कञ्.

f. (-ता)
Likeness, sameness.
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, सदृशंत्वं.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
1 Near, proximate.
2 Of the same country or place.
E.
स for समान the same, and देश country.

f. (-तिः)
1 Felicity or fortune.
2 Good conduct.
E.
सत्, गति going.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Good, pure, virtuous.
2 Excellent, eminent.
E.
सत्, and गुण quality.

m. (-तुः)
(In logic,) The co-existence of cause and effect.
E.
सत् being, हेतु cause.

m. (-वः)
1 A pure or holy disposition or nature.
2 A good temper.
3 Amiability, kindly feeling.
4 The quality or nature of being, entity.
5 The property of goodness.
E.
सत्, and भाव quality.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
True.
E.
सत् true, and भूत been.

n. (-द्म)
1 A house, a dwelling.
2 Water.
E.
षद to go, aff. मनिन्.

f. (-तिः)
A number of houses.
E.
सद्म, and चिति an assemblage.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Done promptly or quickly.
n. (-तं)
A name, an appellation.
E.
सद्यस् instantly, and कृत made.

f. (-था)
Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.)
E.
सद्यस् instantly, and शोथा a swelling.

ind.
Instantly, momentarily, at the moment, in an instant.
E.
स for सम् the same, and द्यस for अहन् a day.

mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं)
New, recent.
E.
सद्यस् in the moment, क्यप् aff.

mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं)
Quick, instantaneous.
E.
सद्यस्, and वुञ् aff.

f. (-ती)
A virtuous maiden.
E.
सत्, and युवती a young woman.

m. (-तः)
A calf.
E.
सद्यस् in a moment, and जात born.

m. (-वी)
A calf.
E.
सद्यस् in a moment, भाविन् being.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Of high birth, of a good race.
E.
सत्, and वंश a race.

m. (-थः)
A village.
E.
सत् good, वस to abide, अथच् aff.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
1 Amiable, well-behaved.
2 Moral, virtuous.
3 Well rounded, handsomely orbicular.
n. (-त्तं)
Amiableness, good or amiable disposition.
E.
सत् good, and वृत्त, selected, &c.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
1 Destroying.
2 Exhausting.
3 Expelling, removing, extracting.
E.
षद to go, causal v., शतृ aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be destroyed.
E.
षद to go, causal v., तव्य aff.

m. (-दिः)
1 A charioteer.
2 A warrior.
E.
षद to be weary, &c., इञ् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Destroyed, exterminated.
2 Wearied, exhausted, harassed.
3 Wasted, decayed.
4 Broken, cut.
5 Drawn, dragged.
E.
षद to go, &c., aff. क्त.

m. (-दी)
1 A horseman, a cavalier.
2 One who rides on an elephant.
3 One who rides on or is mounted in a car.
E.
षद to go, aff. णिनि.

n. (-श्यं)
Resemblance, similarity.
E.
सदृश like, यञ् aff.
